other_measurements.label: mean 24-h IOP
named: Mean change from baseline in mean 24-h IOP (defined as the mean of all eight time points) at day 8/day 9;
result: The reduction from baseline in study eye mean 24-h IOP was statistically significant with netarsudil (3.5 mmHg; P < 0.001) at day 8/day 9 and significantly greater than the reduction from baseline in mean 24-h IOP with vehicle (0.7 mmHg; P < 0.001 for comparison).

other_measurements.label: mean nocturnal IOP
named: The primary efficacy endpoint was mean change from baseline in mean nocturnal IOP (defined as the mean of the four nocturnal time points: 21:00, 00:00, 03:00, and 06:00 h) at day 8/day 9.
result: Netarsudil met the primary efficacy endpoint, with a significant mean reduction from baseline in study eye mean nocturnal IOP (3.5 mmHg; P < 0.001) at day 8/day 9 (Fig. 2a).
